title: FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH, DEAD BUG, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, SIDE PLANK, THEN CAT-COW AND WALL CHEST OPENER. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. SIXTEEN MINUTES. PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, DEAD BUG, BIRD-DOG FOR BALANCE, SIDE PLANK, THEN WE OPEN THE SPINE AND CHEST. THAT CHAIR HAS TURNED YOUR MIDDLE INTO CUSTARD AND YOUR ARMS INTO ORNAMENTS. WE FIX BOTH. MOVE.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. THAT FRIDAY INBOX CAN WAIT, IT'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. ARMS HONEST, CORE LIT, BALANCE TESTED, SPINE AND CHEST OPENED. GOOD FRIDAY. NOW GO SIT DOWN WITHOUT TURNING INTO A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH UPS (FIFTH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR — ABOUT FORTY INCHES. BODY IN ONE LONG LINE FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT FORTY-FIVE FROM THE RIBS, THEN PRESS UP. TEN CLEAN REPS. DO NOT DROP TO A LOWER STEP. QUALITY OVER SPEED. IF YOU NEED A BREATH, HOLD THE TOP BRIEFLY THEN CONTINUE.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE SETS. TEN REPS. LONG LINE. LOWER. PRESS. DO NOT DROP THE STEP. I'M WATCHING. KEEP THEM CLEAN.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST HONEST. GOOD.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, ARMS TO THE CEILING, KNEES BENT OVER THE HIPS. PRESS THE LOW BACK INTO THE FLOOR. SLOWLY REACH ONE ARM BACK AND THE OPPOSITE LEG OUT, THEN RETURN. EIGHT EACH SIDE. RIBS DOWN. NO ARCHING. THIS IS YOUR CORE — CONTROLLED, NOT FLOPPY.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. THREE SETS. EIGHT EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THAT MIDDLE HAS BEEN ON HOLIDAY ALL WEEK. CALL IT BACK TO WORK.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. BREATHE. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUG DONE. CORE LIT. GOOD.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, WRISTS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LEVEL WITH THE TORSO. HOLD A BEAT, RETURN WITH CONTROL. SIX EACH SIDE. HIPS SQUARE. DO NOT WOBBLE LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. HIPS SQUARE. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, FOREARM DOWN, ELBOW UNDER THE SHOULDER. STACK OR STAGGER THE FEET. LIFT THE HIPS INTO A STRAIGHT LINE — HEAD TO HEELS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS, LOWER WITH CONTROL, REPEAT THREE HOLDS EACH SIDE. KNEE-DOWN IS LEGAL IF YOU NEED IT. SIDES HONEST. NO SAGGING HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH HOLD. THREE HOLDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. HIPS UP. STRAIGHT LINE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES WHEN READY. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, WRISTS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE — DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAIL (COW). EXHALE — ROUND THE BACK, TUCK THE CHIN AND PELVIS (CAT). EIGHT SLOW REPS. MOVE WITH THE BREATH. NO FORCING. THIS UNWINDS THE SPINE AFTER THE CORE WORK.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT SLOW. INHALE COW. EXHALE CAT. WITH THE BREATH. THAT SPINE HAS BEEN LOCKED IN A CHAIR ALL MORNING. WAKE IT UP.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE FOREARM AND OPEN HAND ON THE WALL AT ABOUT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW SOFT. GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH ACROSS THE CHEST AND FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. EASY PRESSURE — NO FORCING. RIBS DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. THOSE PUSH UPS WORKED THE FRONT. NOW WE OPEN IT BEFORE THAT DESK HUNCH SETTLES BACK IN.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
